remarks: Unbelievable opportunity to own this 10 acre parcel at the top of Kissing Bridge ski resort. The only slope side ski-in ski-out property available at Kissing Bridge. This mostly wooded parcel has over 1070 feet of ski in/ski out access. Zoned for cluster housing. A rare development opportunity with sewer, water, gas, and electric all available. A consistent gentle slope provides a nice opportunity to build walk-out basement. Long range eastern views. To be split from a larger parcel. Do not walk property without an appointment.
